title: Certify the literal-slot defect that blocks a uniform P104 adjacent c…
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Negative interface certificate. No new κ. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

With \(H^2=H\), \(J_0=I-H\), \(K=T^{-1}\) and arbitrary \(D\), the ordered commutator of the old correction \(P\) with \(L_T\) is
\[
PL_T-L_TP=\begin{pmatrix}-HTK&0\\K(D-I)&KHT\end{pmatrix}
\]
with no assumption that \(H\) commutes with \(T\). When \(HT=TH\), the literal slot swap \(\Pi\) squares to \(I\) and
\[
PA_T-A_TP=\begin{pmatrix}-HK&0\\KJ_0(D-I)-H&KH\end{pmatrix},
\quad A_T=\Pi L_T.
\]
On an N-port amplitude the first bank is \(-Ka\). If two N-port diagonal entries of \(T\) differ, no scalar \(\lambda\) cancels that defect for every such amplitude. A single scale \(t\) gives \(\lambda=-1/t\) on the image of \(H\) only. The ordered conjugate \(L_T P L_T^{-1}\) intertwines \(L_T\); the literal slots require the extra conjugation by \(\Pi\).

This is not an adjacent completed-call pair, a helper-role match, a native tariff, or a supplier. Linear rank is not a call lower bound.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library. Registered replay:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-literal-slot-defect
```

Observed:

```text
PASS_P104_LITERAL_SLOT_DEFECT ordered=general literal=projection_and_commutation distinct_scales=no_scalar constant_scale=-1/2 pi_required=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-literal-slot-defect outcome=negative-result
```

The direct verifier also passes under `-O`. Failure controls: a noncommuting \(T\) keeps the unsimplified ordered identity and rejects the simplified one; a non-projection breaks \(\Pi^2=I\); unequal N-port scales have no scalar; equal scales give \(-1/2\); a \(J_0\) component is not absorbed by that scalar.

Not run: Lean, Docker, a selected cold replay, the 10,816-line census, helper schedules, and hosted CI.

## Open next questions

See `research/p104-literal-slot-defect/README.md`.

- Does one adjacent pair that uses \(\Pi P_{\mathrm{enc}}\Pi\), rather than \(P\), match every helper role as well as both data banks, and is the bill favorable? First step: pin one helper entrance and exit from PR #3954 and price \(\Pi\) as a slot exchange. Blocker: this identity has no helper schedule, and linear rank is not a native tariff.
- Which portwise diagonal corrections other than \(K\) on the image of \(H\) cancel the first bank for every N-port amplitude? First step: name the diagonal alphabet and test two distinct N-port scales. Blocker: that alphabet is a different contract from the old correction.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

A machine-readable open-handoff list that drops requests already covered by an open PR would make parallel sessions agree without reconstructing that filter.
